results.pair_summary: Both documents define the IR (Intermediate Representation) package API, data structure fields (ctx-id, pos, phase, token, score), and core logical invariants (purity, immutability, ordering). Document A is a comprehensive architectural design specification with detailed rationale and Chron-LLM context. Document B is a concise formal interface summary that semantically duplicates the definitions found in Document A without adding unique constraints.
results.integration_rationale: Document A serves as the authoritative source of truth, containing critical architectural context (Delta3 Kernel boundaries, WAL relationship) and explicit formal invariants (IR-1 to IR-4) that cover all content in Document B. Maintaining both files creates a risk of specification drift between the design doc and the interface summary. Recommended action is to merge Document B's concise syntax into Document A as an appendix or reference block for quick lookup, then deprecate Document B.
